snippet.title: Apees V2 Teaser Trailer (1)
snippet.description:
This is the teaser trailer for Apees, coming to the Meta Quest Store later this year!
Jump into intense VR shooter action with two rival teams: Puffer Blasters and Puffer Diffusers.
The Puffer Blasters’ mission? Plant the pufferfish.
The Puffer Diffusers’ mission? Stop it from exploding at all costs.

Discord: https://discord.gg/k82bscUJ
